# Google Address Validation (x402 only)

`POST <service_url>` at **0.02 USDC**:

```json
{"address":{"regionCode":"DE","addressLines":["Europaplatz 1","10557 Berlin"]}}
```

The response carries the standardised address, a geocode, and per-component verdicts
(confirmed, unconfirmed, inferred). Reference:
<https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/address-validation/requests-validate-address>.

For agents: quote with `buy_pay_quote`, pay with `buy_curl` and `maxAmount` from the quote
(atomic units), or `buy curl --max-amount 0.02` (whole tokens). Payment is irreversible.
